Norah's Agency: growth readiness diagnostic

A fictional marketing agency with a real working follow-up system

Norah's Agency combines a short marketing assessment with personalized email follow-ups. It gives prospects an initial experience of the agency's value while creating a clear path toward a sales conversation.

The diagnostic highlights potential gaps across four areas of a business's marketing, giving business owners an initial understanding of where improvements may be needed. It also demonstrates how structured marketing systems can support business growth and invites them to book a complimentary 30-minute Growth Strategy Call for a deeper review and personalized action plan.

After the results are emailed, a follow-up email includes a short review of the prospect's website. This is where AI comes in: Gemini interprets results from Google PageSpeed Insights, a website testing tool, and explains each issue and its potential business impact in plain language. If the website scores 90 or higher across all categories, a shorter follow-up email is sent without the website review.

Responses Documented

Every completed diagnostic is saved as a row in a Google Sheets spreadsheet. The real sheet is private because it holds contact details, so this is a sample view with made-up rows.

Some columns are left out to keep the picture readable.

Built to Solve a Real Problem

For agencies attending networking events, trade shows and business expos, standing out and following up with potential clients can be challenging. In a room full of noise and competing sales pitches, the diagnostic gives prospects something tangible: a personalized look at their marketing gaps and where your agency can help. It turns that first interaction into a structured, automated follow-up process.

  • No lost leads. Every prospect's details and results are saved as soon as the diagnostic is completed, eliminating reliance on business cards or handwritten notes.
  • Follow-up that never gets forgotten. The results email is sent immediately, followed by a second email two business days later, without anyone needing to manage the process manually.
  • Emails that feel personal. Each prospect receives their own results and, where applicable, a review of their website rather than a generic message.
  • No unnecessary follow-ups. If a call is booked through Cal.com before the second email is due, that email is automatically skipped, so prospects are not asked to book a call they already have.
  • Prepared for every call. Each prospect's results highlight which areas of their marketing need the most attention, giving the agency a clearer starting point for the conversation.
  • Findings that can be trusted. Websites are checked twice, and only issues identified in both checks are included, protecting the agency's credibility.
  • One clear view of every lead. A single sheet tracks prospects, their results and follow-up status, keeping everything organized in one place.

Norah's Kitchen: reservation chatbot

A fictional restaurant with a real working booking system

Norah's Kitchen combines a restaurant website with an AI-powered reservation chatbot. It gives guests a convenient way to make reservations at any time while reducing the administrative work involved in managing bookings.

The chatbot introduces guests to the reservation process by collecting their name, preferred date, time, number of guests and phone number. It prompts them for any missing details, confirms each reservation with a booking number, and allows them to change, cancel or look up an existing booking within the same conversation.

This is where AI comes in: Gemini interprets guests' requests in everyday language and determines whether to check, create, change or cancel a reservation. Every booking is saved in Google Sheets, giving the restaurant a centralized, up-to-date record of its reservations.

Book a table

Checks the date is in the future, holds the table for 15 minutes and confirms with a booking number.

Change a booking

Updates the original booking, for example 7pm to 8pm, with no duplicate.

Cancel and look up

Cancels but keeps the record. Guests can look up their details and rebook.

Answer questions

Hours and location: 123 Main Ave, daily 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Groups over 8 call 123-456-7890.

Bookings Documented

Every booking the chatbot makes is saved in this Google Sheets spreadsheet.

View the bookings

Built to Solve a Real Problem

The chatbot automates manual booking work so restaurant staff can dedicate their time to higher-priority tasks throughout the day.

  • No missed bookings. Guests can book any time, even after hours or when the phone is busy. A missed call is a missed table.
  • Less time on the phone. Staff are not stuck taking bookings, repeating hours and directions, or writing details down by hand.
  • Fewer mistakes. The chatbot asks for everything up front, checks the sheet, and gives the guest a booking number, so no double bookings, no missing phone numbers, no guessing.
  • Changes and cancellations handled. Guests can change or cancel by chat, and the same row is updated, so staff do not have to search for it.
  • Staff free for the guests in front of them. Less paperwork and phone time means more time serving the people already in the restaurant.
  • Everything in one place. Every booking sits in one sheet the whole team can see, instead of notes, messages, and phone calls in different places.
